The identification of the maximal times is a hand step \tH\ on top of (MS) (text v43, delta check fix23 W-4). Let $\Phi$, $T_{\max}$ be the maximal flow of Lemma ``maximal smooth solution'' of \fn{U1_regularity_v43.tex} ((T1) for $F=\gamma(t_1)$). For $0<T<T_{\max}$, $\Phi|_{[0,T]}$ is an \fn{IsFlow} from $\gamma(t_1)$, so the uniqueness clause of (MS) gives $T<T_*-t_1$ and $\Phi=\gamma(t_1+\cdot)$ on $[0,T]$. For $0<T<T_*-t_1$, $\gamma(t_1+\cdot)$ is an \fn{IsFlow} on $[0,T]$ from $\gamma(t_1)$ by the existence clause of (MS), so clause (ii) of (T1) gives $T<T_{\max}$. Hence $T_{\max}=T_*-t_1$, and the two flows agree on $[0,T_{\max})$.
